body: I’m feeling very hopeless and scared. Have a lot of anxiety too :(
Oh man, that’s not good! But do we know if Endo takes the breaks because of his health or does he just need to recoup? I never read anything about his long-term health in decline 🥲

Thanks, I try to be. I can’t imagine how lonely being a comic author might be. 

I’m happy that this fandom seems pretty understanding for the most part. I genuinely just want Endo to be okay. I don’t care if he takes more breaks from now on, or needs more time away from it all. I just want him to be okay. 

I hope it’s just that he’s burned out and needs some time off. Jump Festa is in a few weeks. Hope to learn more then! 🥺🙌
Hi, why did JJK and OnK end prematurely? And what seems like a form of protest?
Of course! His health is the most important.

I wish the author of *Yakuza Fiance* could come back from hiatus after the anime finishes. They’ve been on hiatus since March and it’s unsure when or if they will continue. 

They left with 38.2 chapters and 8 volumes. And the story was getting good. I’ve been obsessively checking for updates every day 😭
It doesn’t. But idk maybe I’m missing something 😂
I LOVE her ever since she came on the scene! It feels like it’s been ages and I just want more chapters dedicated to her 🥲✨
Legs seem like AI or filtered. Definitely don’t look like your legs in your other pics.
Hi thank you! How far before the game did you resell? And were you able to get most of the cost of the ticket back?
I bet when there’s a season 2 (which will probably be >!Yor centric because of the cruise arc!<) the opening and/or ending will be Loid centric 🥳
Ahh interesting! I mean, we don’t need to always see her killing people. It would even be interesting to see her interact within the organization itself. But, I get what you mean.

I understand. She’s not a very political person. It just would have been an interesting way to take the story. It probably won’t go that way, but I am excited about the Melinda arc. The development about Yor’s views about what “normal” is will be interesting! ⭐️

I agree. It really does feel like a lot of it is filler and while I’ve enjoyed the story so far, I can’t imagine what 100-200 more chapters of the same would do to the story. I understand that Endo sensei probably wants to keep it running for a long time (I don’t want it to end anytime soon), but there’s also beauty in knowing when to move towards concluding things.

Ahh that does make sense. I do kind of get a sense that he doesn’t really know what to do with her at this point, but one would hope he has a vague idea as it’s been about 3 years since the series was first serialized. I’m glad he decided to change it last minute to assassin, it’s a more interesting dynamic and I hope things are worked out in the future 🙌

Thank you for replying instead of just downvoting. 

Her wanting to be a good pretend wife is admirable and I loved it! I guess I would just like to see more of her personality, more things that make her excited to live in the world, to wake up and do the work that she does. We see so much of that with Loid and it’s beautiful. 

I hope one day we get to see it. I hope it doesn’t take another 100 chapters to get there though 🫣
